Make an impact with NTT DATA
 Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
 Your day at NTT DATA
 In this role you will be joining a team of technical professionals supporting a large-scale z/OS systems platform. This position requires an experienced systems programmer supporting the z/OS Mainframe Network environment. Responsibilities include configuring and maintaining the integrity and data/IP security of the Mainframe's host communication subsystems and associated program products.
 Your responsibilities will include: 
Being part of a multi-functional team, supporting IBM mainframe networks and transmissions products and infrastructure.
Participation in support rota providing 24x7 cover.
Perform TCPIP Port Reserves (Additions, Deletions, Changes) Perform VTAM updates (Additions, Deletions, Changes)
Manage OSA Adapters in a complex mainframe environment
Perform VTAM PU/LU updates (Additions, Deletions, Changes) including Enterprise Extenders (EE)
Implement AT-TLS rules (digital certificate management). Configure and manage IPSEC policies (permit/deny rules, VPN- ipsec tunnels)
Trace, Debug and Error Analysis
Communicate regularly with technical, applications and operational staff to ensure Network connectivity and security (may involve some after hours and weekend work)
 The ideal candidate for this role will have the below experience and qualifications:
Experience in administering file transmissions products such as Connect:Direct and FTP, or alternatively good experience as a user of these products.
Knowledge of z/OS and z/OS utilities. 
Understanding of z/OS networking services, structure and related software and protocols.
Understanding of network security disciplines (IPSec, TLS/SSL, certificates, etc) and how they relate to file transmission.
Experience of problem management from initial diagnosis through to resolution.
Understanding of the Change Management process.
Ability to customize and manage secure SNA and TCP/IP networks under z/OS.
Knowledge of mainframe network management tools, e.g. NetMaster, and multi-session manager products such as TUBES and Supersession.
Experience of managing mainframe printing products.
General z/OS systems programming experience.
Knowledge of System z hardware including the OSA-Express network cards.
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
Good communication, teamwork and negotiation skills
Familiarity with the Cisco Network Solutions 
The ability to work to tight deadlines under pressure
Good organisational skills
Flexibility and adaptability
The ability to create and maintain strong working relationships with colleagues and customers
Business awareness and understanding of business requirements of IT
A willingness to keep up to date with developments in new technology
An understanding of information legislation, such as the Data Protection Act.
Experience of working as a z/OS Systems Specialist in the IT industry.
